issue.title: sase repo open rejects configured sidecars when inventory uses the project display name
issue.description: Independently reproduced during research synthesis at primary commit 875447e2142f71dc04daeb49eab72c655c343be7. Root cause: match_repo_record filters RepoRecord.project against ProjectContext.project_name, but inventory records carry project=sase and project_key=gh_sase-org__sase while host context uses the canonical key. All configured candidates are removed before repository resolution. The unknown-repo diagnostic repeats the same comparison. A process-local normalization of record.project to record.project_key allowed the unchanged audited repo-open handler to resolve the correct existing research checkout. No tracked source or global config was changed. Fix identity comparisons and add regression coverage using distinct display names and canonical keys. Size small because the exact mismatched fields and reproducer are established. Checked all-status task searches, the past-week task sweep, and active epics; canonical-wire epic sase-x7.5.1.4 concerns Patch/catalog contracts rather than this inventory identity mismatch.

task_type_fields.impact: Agents cannot use the mandated audited repo-open path for configured sidecars and linked repos when project display names differ from canonical keys.
task_type_fields.repro: From an existing numbered sase workspace, run sase repo list --json and observe research with project=sase and project_key=gh_sase-org__sase. Run sase repo open research -r "Read research reports": exits 2 with Unknown repo and only gh_sase-org__sase listed as valid. The configured slug sase--research fails identically.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced during sase-zl landing at primary 9202146ca: sase repo list advertises linked sase-core, but sase repo open sase-core reports Unknown repo for project gh_sase-org__sase and only the canonical project key as valid. Explicit -p sase also fails with no WORKSPACE_DIR. Sanctioned gh:sase-org/sase-core open works. Same configured display-name/canonical-key resolution root; blocked required landing source inspection until external fallback. Audit file:explicit:b356c51cb45677f60961e909.
